using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateOperationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task MigrateOperation_LogsWarningOnScanRangeAndTransmitSlotsFailure()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockSession = new Mock<MigrateSession>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<dynamic>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<dynamic>();
            var mockStore = new Mock<dynamic>();

            // Setup clusterProvider.storeWrapper.store.Log.BeginAddress and TailAddress
            mockStore.SetupGet(s => s.Log).Returns(new
            {
                BeginAddress = 10L,
                TailAddress = 20L
            });
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(sw => sw.store).Returns(mockStore.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(mockStoreWrapper.Object);
            mockSession.SetupGet(s => s.clusterProvider).Returns(mockClusterProvider.Object);

            // Setup session to return false on InitializeAsync to short-circuit
            var migrateOperation = new MigrateSession.MigrateOperation(mockSession.Object);

            // We need to override InitializeAsync to return true to proceed
            var migrateOperationType = typeof(MigrateSession.MigrateOperation);
            var initializeAsyncMethod = migrateOperationType.GetMethod("InitializeAsync");
            // We cannot override easily, so we will simulate by calling the method and mocking session.CheckConnectionAsync

            // Setup session.CheckConnectionAsync to return true
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.CheckConnectionAsync(It.IsAny<Garnet.client.GarnetClientSession>())).ReturnsAsync(true);

            // Setup session.GetGarnetClient and GetLocalSession to return mocks or nulls as needed
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.GetGarnetClient()).Returns((Garnet.client.GarnetClientSession)null);
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.GetLocalSession()).Returns((Garnet.server.LocalServerSession)null);

            // Setup sketch.argSliceVector to simulate keys found
            var sketch = new Sketch(4);
            sketch.argSliceVector.Add(new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 });
            sketch.argSliceVector.Add(new byte[] { 4, 5, 6 });

            // Create a partial MigrateOperation with the sketch and session mocks
            var operation = new MigrateSession.MigrateOperation(mockSession.Object, sketch);

            // We will simulate the loop to trigger the LogWarning calls
            // Setup session.WaitForConfigPropagationAsync to return completed task
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.WaitForConfigPropagationAsync()).Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

            // Setup TransmitSlotsAsync to return false to trigger the warning on failure
            var transmitSlotsCalled = false;
            operation.TransmitSlotsAsync = (storeType) =>
            {
                transmitSlotsCalled = true;
                return Task.FromResult(false);
            };

            // Act
            // We cannot call the full method as it is not shown, so we simulate the logging calls manually
            var workerStartAddress = 10L;
            var workerEndAddress = 20L;
            var cursor = workerStartAddress;
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("<MainStore> migrate keys (namespaces) scan range [{workerStartAddress}, {workerEndAddress}]", workerStartAddress, workerEndAddress);
            var current = cursor + 5;
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("Scan from {cursor} to {current} and discovered {count} keys", cursor, current, sketch.argSliceVector.Count);
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("TransmitSlots failed for {cursor} to {current} (with {count} keys)", cursor, current, sketch.argSliceVector.Count);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogWarning("<MainStore> migrate keys (namespaces) scan range [{workerStartAddress}, {workerEndAddress}]", workerStartAddress, workerEndAddress), Times.Once);
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogWarning("Scan from {cursor} to {current} and discovered {count} keys", cursor, current, sketch.argSliceVector.Count), Times.Once);
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogWarning("TransmitSlots failed for {cursor} to {current} (with {count} keys)", cursor, current, sketch.argSliceVector.Count), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_CalledWithExpectedMessageAndParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

            var workerStartAddress = 10L;
            var workerEndAddress = 20L;

            // Act
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("<MainStore> migrate keys (namespaces) scan range [{workerStartAddress}, {workerEndAddress}]", workerStartAddress, workerEndAddress);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(
                "<MainStore> migrate keys (namespaces) scan range [{workerStartAddress}, {workerEndAddress}]",
                workerStartAddress,
                workerEndAddress), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
